about: RunPapers colours, named after the H&E stain on a glass slide: hematoxylin (blue-violet ink) and eosin (pink). Contrast ratios are WCAG 2 against the colour named.

colors.name: Hematoxylin
colors.use: text, headings, the logo's axes; 12.6:1 on white

colors.name: Eosin
colors.use: the logo's run triangle and large accents only (4.2:1 on white: not for small text)

colors.name: Eosin ink
colors.use: links and primary buttons (white text on it 5.3:1)

colors.name: Eosin bright
colors.use: the run triangle on dark backgrounds (4.7:1 on hematoxylin)

colors.name: Eosin wash
colors.use: the copy-prompt panel and highlights (hematoxylin on it 11.2:1)

colors.name: Counterstain
colors.use: secondary text: authors, dates, counts (6.0:1 on slide)
